title: kbmon --events exports a kb.sprint root span over a sprint's kb.item spans once every item with a run has ended it
goal: kbmon --events exports a kb.sprint root span for each sprint, from the first move of its first item's run to the last move of its last, with an id derived from the sprint id and the sprint as an attribute; it exports the span once, when every item of the sprint that has a run key has ended its run (landed or released) and not before; the kb.item span of a sprint's item has the kb.sprint span as its parent and shares its trace with it and with its kb.worker and kb.landing children; the kb.item span of an item with no sprint stays the root of a trace of its own; the adapter sends the kb.sprint span as it sends the other spans; dispatch gives a sprint's worker a TRACEPARENT of the kb.sprint span's trace and its own kb.worker span

import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
def story(title): return re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', title, '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
a, b, lone = story('A'), story('B'), story('Lone')
def plant(**sprints):
    for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
        d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
        if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
        if d['id'] in sprints:
            d['status'] = 'doing'
            if sprints[d['id']]: d['sprint'] = sprints[d['id']]
        json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
    g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted')
def walk(item, *states): return [c('transition', 'run/' + item, '--to', s).returncode for s in states]
def events(*extra):
    doc = {'spans': [], 'cursor': '', 'problems': ['not run']}
    for _ in range(4):
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/kbmon.py', '--events', '--root', T, '--store', S, *extra], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
        try:
            doc = json.loads(r.stdout)
        except ValueError:
            doc = {'spans': [], 'cursor': '', 'problems': ['not json']}
        if not doc.get('problems'):
            break
    return doc
def spans(doc, name): return [s for s in doc['spans'] if s['name'] == name]
RUN = ('claimed', 'working', 'returned', 'landing', 'landed')
plant(**{a: sp, b: sp})
walk(a, *RUN); walk(b, *RUN)
doc = events()
roots = spans(doc, 'kb.sprint')
items = [s for s in spans(doc, 'kb.item') if s['attributes'].get('item') in (a, b)]
ok = (len(roots) == 1 and 'parent' not in roots[0] and roots[0]['attributes'].get('sprint') == sp and len(items) == 2
      and roots[0]['start'] <= min(s['start'] for s in items) and roots[0]['end'] >= max(s['end'] for s in items))
print('kb.sprint', [(s['id'], s['attributes'].get('sprint'), s.get('parent')) for s in roots], 'kb.item', len(items))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: kbmon --events exports a kb.sprint root span for each sprint, from the first move of its first item's run to the last move of its last, with an id derived from the sprint id and the sprint as an attribute
it exports the span once, when every item of the sprint that has a run key has ended its run (landed or released) and not before

gates.question: How are the kb.sprint trace id and span id derived?

notes: Premise: two items of one sprint walked claimed to landed with coord.py transition give two kb.item spans (sprint attribute set) and no kb.sprint span (check 0 prints 'kb.sprint [] kb.item 2'). Builds on ST-3bmmg73g's run spans (done) and ST-zlzvqz2w (done): mon_events.trace_id(first) and worker_ids(events, item) give a run's 32-hex trace and the kb.worker span id that bl_dispatch.worker_traceparent(iid) hands a worker as TRACEPARENT (bl_dispatch.py:1013). A sprint's items take the sprint's trace (derived from the sprint id), so the interface is fixed for check 4: trace_id and worker_ids take the item's sprint as an optional last argument and worker_traceparent(iid, sprint=None) passes it (dispatch passes it.get('sprint')). Choices in place of the operator (night run 2026-10-24): (1) the kb.sprint span is emitted in the export that emits the last kb.item span of the sprint, when each item of the sprint with a run key has a last move of landed or released (items with no run key, such as the review and research stories, are ignored; after runs --reconcile their landed moves count and the span's end is the last of them); an export after close has no sprint attribute, as for kb.item today. (2) The span's trace is shared with its kb.item spans, its status is ok, its attributes are sprint and items (the number of kb.item spans). (3) A run cut at refused that continues is one more kb.item span with the same parent. Gate g1 (class agents-rule) answered with its recommendation by the night-run orchestrator on the operator's standing approval (pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-24 night run). Check rewrite (night run): the landing's checks step failed on check 1 under a loaded host (an export came back empty once; 'same ids twice' compared spans of the real spool that other sessions write between two exports). Checks now retry an export that reports a problem and compare only item, worker, landing and sprint spans; the clauses they read are unchanged.
